description:
<workdir>/control.json: written atomically by the agent for every job, at start (`{"seq": 0}`) and on every
change, each change followed by a nudge: SIGUSR1 to the runner process on POSIX, the inherited event named by
OARBANK_CONTROL_EVENT on Windows. The runner re-reads the document when nudged and acts at its next safe point; it
never re-reads on a timer. Absent fields mean "no constraint". [stable]

gpu_duty.description: [beta] Max GPU duty fraction (reduce batch size/concurrency).
gpu_duty.title: Gpu Duty

pause.description: [stable] Hold at the next safe point until a newer document clears it (cooperative_pause).
pause.title: Pause

stop.description: [stable] Finish now: exit non-zero (or write a result if done) within stop_grace_s; the agent then terminates the process container.
stop.title: Stop

title: Control
